data.description:
## Description

**What**: Extend dso:completion-verifier to validate Strata-detected runs: (a) commands.* matches strata-config-defaults.conf for the detected variant; (b) all 5 Rails-Strata footguns present when framework:strata-rails; (c) ## Strata Posture exists in project-understanding.md.
**Why**: Verifier closes the loop on the silent writes — if any sub-file silently fails, the verifier catches the gap.
**Scope**:
- IN: Verifier additions to existing dso:completion-verifier flow; presence checks; cross-reference to shared defaults file for commands.* match.
- OUT: Behavioral fidelity tests for the verifier itself (covered by S1 fixtures).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, verifier reports failure when commands.* drifts from shared defaults on Strata projects ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, verifier reports failure when any of the 5 footguns are missing on Rails-Strata projects ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, verifier reports failure when ## Strata Posture is missing on Strata projects ← Satisfies: SC4
- When complete, verifier reports zero failures on non-Strata projects ← Satisfies: SC5
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for each new check

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Verifier fails closed — any uncertainty surfaces as a flagged finding

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a verifier, dso:completion-verifier validates Strata-detected runs
